description: This file defines CLI commands and functions for managing imports in the Mattermost server, including upload, delete, list, validate, and process import files, as well as handling import jobs and validation statistics.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Struct for holding various import statistics counts.

classes.name: ImportValidationResult
classes.description: Struct for holding validation results including filename, total lines, elapsed time, and errors.

methods.name: importListIncompleteCmdF
methods.description: Lists incomplete import uploads for the user.

methods.name: importUploadCmdF
methods.description: Handles uploading an import file, with support for resuming uploads.

methods.name: importDeleteCmdF
methods.description: Deletes an import file by name.

methods.name: importProcessCmdF
methods.description: Starts an import process job, with options for local file processing and content extraction.

methods.name: importJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Shows details of a specific import job.

methods.name: importValidateCmdF
methods.description: Validates an import file, performs checks against server state, and outputs statistics.

methods.name: configurePrinter
methods.description: Configures the printer for output formatting.
